verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated writing-skills SKILL.md that documents how to author and test new skills. It treats skill writing as TDD applied to process documentation and notes where skills live, including the cross-runtime `~/.agents/skills/` path. So a developer has first-party guidance rather than having to reverse-engineer existing skills. However, the evidence never shows a fill-in template or the required name/description frontmatter fields, and the guidance reads as a methodology more than a scaffold. Missing for 10: an explicit SKILL.md template, documentation of the name/description frontmatter schema, independent or hands-on corroboration of authoring a skill from the docs.
